title: How to add a business location on Google Maps
description: Check existing profiles, prepare accurate business information and follow the official Google Business Profile process.
answer: Eligible businesses can add or claim a Google Business Profile through Google’s official process. Check for an existing profile first and follow the requests shown in the owner’s account. Lumi does not operate the profile for you.

author: lumi-local

children.text: A map place is not the same as management access
A visible map location does not establish who can manage the business information. Owners should use the Google Business Profile process for representing an eligible business.
Read Google’s eligibility guidance before adding an address, particularly if the business serves an area rather than receiving customers at a storefront.

Search for the business name and actual location. If a profile exists, use Google’s add or claim guidance. Do not create another copy simply because you cannot sign in. An ownership request may be the appropriate path.

If there is no profile, start through Google’s official Business Profile page. Buttons differ across devices and dates; the important decision is whether to add a new business or claim an existing one.
Use the real trading name, relevant business category, owner-controlled phone number and opening hours. Choose the address or service area according to how the business actually serves customers.
Do not place the business in a convenient city centre to look closer to searchers. Do not add advertising keywords to the name. Confirm uncertain details with the owner before submitting them.
Complete the steps Google displays, including verification when requested. Submission does not guarantee immediate visibility or a high ranking. Keep a record of the work and any further notices.
Use an owner-controlled account with recovery options protected. Assign responsibility for information updates rather than leaving the business’s digital asset in a supplier’s personal account.

Test the directions link on a phone against the real entrance. Check whether the website explains services, hours and contact options. This checks the visitor’s path; it is not a verification shortcut or ranking technique.

Lumi can prepare a website, Call/Zalo actions and directions links using owner-confirmed information. The owner retains Google account control. Lumi does not create, verify, edit or manage the profile.

If adding or verifying a profile is your only task, try Google’s free process first. Evaluate Lumi when you also need a service website, QR artwork or the agreed publishing work. Buy the scope that addresses your actual problem.
